dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Yeah! But it's not just the "latest" novel! It's the draft of a yet-to-be-published work!

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: You have probably heard of Yae Publishing House already, right? The owner of this publishing house is the Guuji Yae herself, our head shrine maiden.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Ever since Lady Yae learned that I am a novel enthusiast, she would often offer me the drafts of Yae Publishing House novels to read.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Let me tell you a secret. When Lady Yae is acting as the boss of Yae Publishing House, she behaves very differently than she does as the Guuji. She's actually really kind and often asks me about my thoughts on these new novels.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Hehe, if my silly comments can help her out, that's nice, then.
